name: EigenLayer
description: EigenLayer, now part of EigenCloud, is a restaking protocol on Ethereum. It lets stakers restake ETH, liquid-staking tokens and EIGEN to secure additional services (AVSs) in exchange for extra rewards, at the risk of slashing.
description_zh: EigenLayer（现属 EigenCloud）是以太坊上的再质押协议。它允许质押者再质押 ETH、流动性质押代币和 EIGEN，为额外服务（AVS）提供安全保障并获得额外奖励，同时承担被罚没的风险。

geo_site.method: 2024 reports: IP blocks on the EIGEN claim site (US, CA, CN, CU, KP, IR, VE). 2026-10-12: app.eigenlayer.xyz answers visitors from Ukraine (2 networks) with 'RESTRICTED: The application is not available to persons in your jurisdiction'.

live: app.eigenlayer.xyz (2026-10-12): UA -> 'RESTRICTED: The application is not available to persons in your jurisdiction'; 19 other countries -> HTTP 500 (the app is down)
